binary_weights: Both layers use only +/-1 signs times per-output positive digital gains; differential GH/GL pair per sign.
hidden_activation: Digital clipped ReLU [0,1], rounded to8 bits; straight-through derivative for rounding during training. Inputs are unchanged5-bit pixels0..16.
selection: For each QAT configuration/budget, retain the checkpoint with minimum training cross entropy within that budget. Select configuration/budget by inner-validation correct count, then validation cross entropy, then earlier budget. Refit on all1347 examples with the same training-loss checkpoint policy and selected budget; do not select on test score.
continuous_initializer: 200 epochs, Adam lr0.003, same architecture and8-bit activations, fit on inner training only during selection.
hardware_scope: Same four COMSOL histories and five short snapshots; same seeds0..99 assignment policy extended to both layer shapes. Frozen-state inference only; ideal periphery/interconnect.
adaptive_correction: Initial last-checkpoint run is archived in initial_last_checkpoint. Its final full-training accuracy dropped to84% while earlier training checkpoints were around93%, exposing sign-flip instability. One bounded correction applies training-loss checkpoint retention consistently in inner selection and full refit. The earlier test score was already observed; final evaluation reuses that cohort and is exploratory, not a fresh independent test.
